description: This file defines API endpoints for managing comments on work items within a project. It includes data models, utility functions for user resolution, and HTTP routes for listing and adding comments, integrating with a Supabase backend.

classes.name: Comment
classes.description: Represents a comment entity linked to a work item, including metadata such as author details and creation timestamp.

classes.name: CreateCommentRequest
classes.description: Data model for the payload required to create a new comment, including validation.

methods.name: SupabaseClient get_supabase(settings=Depends(get_settings))
methods.description: Provides a Supabase client instance using configuration settings.

methods.name: tuple[Optional[str],Optional[str]] _resolve_user_from_bearer_token( supabase: SupabaseClient, authorization: Optional[str], )
methods.description: Resolves user ID and display name from an Authorization Bearer token, with fallbacks and error handling.

methods.name: List[Comment] list_comments( project_id: str = Path(..., description="UUID of the project"), id: int = Path(..., description="Numeric item id within the project"), supabase: SupabaseClient = Depends(get_supabase), )
methods.description: Retrieves all comments associated with a specific work item, ordered by creation time.

methods.name: Comment add_comment( project_id: str = Path(..., description="UUID of the project"), id: int = Path(..., description="Numeric item id within the project"), payload: CreateCommentRequest = ..., supabase: SupabaseClient = Depends(get_supabase), authorization: Optional[str] = Header(default=None, alias="Authorization"), _: None = Depends(require_auth), )
methods.description: Creates a new comment for a work item, leveraging user identity resolution and handling insertion into the database.
